name: Moira MacLeod
bio:
Moira MacLeod's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track but in the shipyards of Glasgow. Her precision welding skills, honed over years crafting massive metal structures, caught the eye of a local rally team needing reliable roll cages. The transition was seamless, her experience translating directly into the demanding world of fabrication for racing vehicles. Moira's methodical approach ensures every weld, every bracket, meets the highest standards of safety and performance.

At Toyota Gazoo Racing BR, Moira is known for her unflappable demeanor and her willingness to mentor younger members of the team. She believes in passing on her knowledge and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Her flexibility is a valuable asset, allowing her to adapt to changing project demands and tight deadlines without compromising quality.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped, and slightly wavy
physical.description: Moira is a stout woman with kind eyes and a no-nonsense air about her.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn book of welding techniques.
Prefers listening to classic rock while working, especially AC/DC.
Has a habit of cleaning her workspace meticulously before starting any new project.
